title: Game night
description: The LAN night live, for a second monitor: open with ?kiosk. Green, orange, red at the top left.

panels.title: The server
panels.description: The worst of the last 10 s. Green: all good. Orange: the tick or the event loop is busy; nothing to do yet. Red for more than a few seconds: see lan/cheatsheet.html.

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace((max(max_over_time(brieltje_tick_seconds{stat="p99"}[10s])) > bool 0.03) + (max(max_over_time(brieltje_tick_seconds{stat="p99"}[10s])) > bool 0.045), "part", "tick", "", "")
  or label_replace((max(max_over_time(brieltje_event_loop_delay_seconds{stat="p99"}[10s])) > bool 0.05) + (max(max_over_time(brieltje_event_loop_delay_seconds{stat="p99"}[10s])) > bool 0.1), "part", "loop", "", "")
  or label_replace(3 * (1 - max(up{job="game"})), "part", "up", "", "")
)

panels.title: Tick p99, last 10 s
panels.description: The slowest 1 % of the game's ticks, the worst 2 s of the last 10 s. Its budget is 50 ms.

panels.title: Round trip p95
panels.description: 95 % of the players' connections are this fast or faster (WebSocket ping, every 2 s).

panels.title: Over 150 ms
panels.description: Players whose round trip is over 150 ms now. Who: the host page.

panels.title: The game's tick and the event loop (budget 50 ms)
panels.description: Each game ticks 20 times a second. Past 50 ms everyone stutters. The bands are the games played.

panels.title: Round trip to the players
panels.description: From the server to each page and back, every 2 s: the middle player, the 95th percentile, the slowest. Over 150 ms a player feels it.

panels.title: Messages in a second, by type
Sent: the game's messages, its files, the network
Dropped and unanswered
panels.description: Messages a page sent too fast (the rate limits), and pings a page did not answer in 2 s.

panels.title: Processor
panels.description: The game: its share of one core (it runs on one). The PC: all its cores together.

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: The longest pause since the last scrape, and the time spent collecting each second.

panels.title: HTTP: the first load of every phone
